commits.body:

- Parse notification_type field for precise status detection (permission_prompt, idle_prompt, elicitation_dialog)
- Add plan_approval detection via permission_mode='plan'
- Create stop.sh script and auto-configure Stop hook in Claude settings
- More reliable status: no false positives, precise attention reasons
